options.content:
# 💶 My money — everything in one place
Plain words, one calm colour. All amounts in euros (1.234,56). Updates by itself (bank sync every morning; page refreshes every 30 min).

panels.title: 🛟 Breathing room before the overdraft wall  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT((SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='overdraft_limit')+(SELECT base_balance FROM balances WHERE account_id='ing-checking' ORDER BY as_of DESC LIMIT 1),2,'de_DE')) AS v

panels.title: 🏦 In the bank now — checking  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(base_balance,2,'de_DE')) AS v FROM balances WHERE account_id='ing-checking' ORDER BY as_of DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: 💧 Total in all synced accounts  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(base_balance),2,'de_DE')) AS Liquid FROM (SELECT base_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY as_of DESC) rn FROM balances) z WHERE rn=1

panels.title: 🤝 I owe friends — Ilias + Christos  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT((SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='debt_friends'),2,'de_DE')) AS v

options.content: ## ② THIS MONTH — am I on plan?

panels.title: 📊 Spent so far this month  (bar fills toward my monthly plan)

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(-SUM(base_amount),2),0) FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')

panels.title: 💶 Spent so far this month  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(z.v,2,'de_DE')) AS v FROM (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(-SUM(base_amount),2),0) AS v FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')) z

panels.title: ✅ Spare each month if I follow the plan  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT((SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='income_monthly')-(SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='REDACTED_6c219e94'),2,'de_DE')) AS v

panels.title: 📥 Income landed this month  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(base_amount),2),0),2,'de_DE')) AS v FROM v_income_canonical WHERE booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')

panels.title: 🛒 Biggest spending areas this month  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.`Where it goes`, s.`Spent` AS `bar`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(s.`Spent`,2,'de_DE')) AS `amt` FROM (SELECT CASE t.category WHEN 'online-shopping' THEN 'Online shopping' WHEN 'card-spending' THEN 'Credit-card bill (detail comes with the statement)' WHEN 'groceries' THEN 'Food (groceries)' WHEN 'mortgage' THEN 'Home (mortgage)' WHEN 'online-services' THEN 'Apps & subscriptions' WHEN 'electronics-homelab' THEN 'Gear / electronics' WHEN 'takeaway-delivery' THEN 'Takeaway' WHEN 'loans' THEN 'Loan payments' WHEN 'electric-gas' THEN 'Electric & gas' WHEN 'greece-family' THEN 'Family (Greece)' WHEN 'internet-mobile' THEN 'Internet / mobile' WHEN 'supplements-fitness' THEN 'Supplements' WHEN 'health-insurance-nn' THEN 'Health insurance' WHEN 'water-dunea' THEN 'Water' WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Money moved onto the credit card' WHEN 'taxes' THEN 'Taxes' WHEN 'travel-insurance-asr' THEN 'Travel insurance' WHEN 'liability-insurance-asr' THEN 'Liability insurance' WHEN 'legal-insurance-de-vereende' THEN 'Legal insurance' WHEN 'card-fee' THEN 'Bank / card fees' ELSE COALESCE(t.category,'Not sorted yet') END AS `Where it goes`, ROUND(-SUM(t.base_amount),2) AS `Spent` FROM v_spend_canonical t WHERE t.booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6) s ORDER BY s.`Spent` DESC

panels.title: 🎯 Groceries & takeaway — am I keeping the plan this month?  (€)
panels.description: Plan = the v6 budget target (stored in budget_plan; update it when v6 changes). Pace = spent so far ÷ days passed × days in the month. Spent so far = bank charges + online orders (Flink / Albert Heijn / Thuisbezorgd) from your receipt emails not yet charged to the bank, so card-paid grocery/takeaway orders count immediately and never twice (an order drops out once the card statement imports and reconciles to it). In-store PIN groceries still come only from the bank feed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT x.`What it is`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(x.plan_v,2,'de_DE')) AS `The plan / month`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(x.spent,2,'de_DE')) AS `Spent so far`, CASE WHEN DAY(CURDATE())<5 THEN '— (month just started)' ELSE CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(ROUND(x.spent/DAY(CURDATE())*DAY(LAST_DAY(CURDATE())),2),2,'de_DE')) END AS `Whole month, at this pace`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(x.avg6,2,'de_DE')) AS `Average / month, last 6 months`, CASE WHEN x.plan_v-x.spent>=0 THEN CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(x.plan_v-x.spent,2,'de_DE'),' still available') ELSE CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(x.spent-x.plan_v,2,'de_DE'),' OVER the plan') END AS `Where I stand` FROM (SELECT 'Groceries' AS `What it is`, (SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='REDACTED_0433b104') AS plan_v, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(-SUM(base_amount),2) FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE category='groceries' AND booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(order_eur) FROM order_recon WHERE merchant IN ('Flink','Albert Heijn') AND recon='no_bank_charge' AND ordered_at>=DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) AS spent, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(-SUM(base_amount)/6,2) FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE category='groceries' AND booked_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND booked_date<DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) AS avg6 UNION ALL SELECT 'Takeaway / delivery' AS `What it is`, (SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='REDACTED_49cb8333') AS plan_v, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(-SUM(base_amount),2) FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE category='takeaway-delivery' AND booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(order_eur) FROM order_recon WHERE merchant IN ('Thuisbezorgd') AND recon='no_bank_charge' AND ordered_at>=DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) AS spent, COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(-SUM(base_amount)/6,2) FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE category='takeaway-delivery' AND booked_date>=DATE_SUB(DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01'),INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND booked_date<DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')),0) AS avg6) x

panels.title: 🏷️ My staples on bonus this week — Albert Heijn  (€)
panels.description: This week's AH Bonus offers matched to products I actually buy repeatedly (from my AH + Flink receipt history). Fed weekly (Mon 06:45) by deals_sync.py from the AH mobile API; matching verdicts are cached in product_match — ambiguous pairs are judged once by the LLM and never alerted on when unsure. A '—' under Nu means a multi-buy deal (the Deal column is the whole story, e.g. '2 voor 3.99'). Empty table = none of my staples is in the bonus this week.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ro.product_text AS `Product`, IFNULL(ro.unit_size,'') AS `Formaat`, COALESCE(ro.mechanism,'bonus') AS `Deal`, IFNULL(CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(ro.old_price,2,'de_DE')), '—') AS `Was`, IFNULL(CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(ro.price,2,'de_DE')), '—') AS `Nu`, DATE_FORMAT(ro.valid_to, '%d-%m') AS `T/m` FROM retail_offers ro JOIN product_match pm ON pm.offer_key = CONCAT('ah:', ro.offer_key) AND pm.verdict = 'match' WHERE ro.source='ah-api' AND ro.week_tag = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%x-W%v') GROUP BY ro.offer_key, ro.product_text, ro.unit_size, ro.mechanism, ro.old_price, ro.price, ro.valid_to ORDER BY ro.product_text, ro.old_price DESC

panels.title: 🛒 My most-bought groceries — Albert Heijn + Flink receipts  (€)
panels.description: Top products by total spend, from itemised AH invoices + Flink receipts stored in MariaDB (ah_invoice_items + flink_order_items). All-time from receipts: AH covers Apr 2025 onward; Flink only the itemised Dutch receipts (Aug 2024 onward), so Flink products are a floor. Deposits/packaging excluded; the same coffee can appear as several SKUs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT description AS `Product`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(eur),2,'de_DE')) AS `Totaal`, SUM(qty) AS `Keer gekocht`, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT winkel ORDER BY winkel SEPARATOR ' + ') AS `Winkel` FROM (SELECT description, incl_btw AS eur, quantity AS qty, 'AH' AS winkel FROM ah_invoice_items WHERE is_deposit=0 AND incl_btw>0 UNION ALL SELECT description, line_total, quantity, 'Flink' FROM flink_order_items) z WHERE description NOT LIKE '%Bezorgbundel%' AND description NOT LIKE '%Premium Abonnement%' GROUP BY description ORDER BY SUM(eur) DESC LIMIT 15

options.content: ## ③ WHERE IT GOES — averages & commitments

panels.title: 🛒 Where my money goes — average per month, last 6 months  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.`Where it goes`, s.`Per month` AS `bar`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(s.`Per month`,2,'de_DE')) AS `amt` FROM (SELECT CASE t.category WHEN 'online-shopping' THEN 'Online shopping' WHEN 'card-spending' THEN 'Credit-card bill (detail comes with the statement)' WHEN 'groceries' THEN 'Food (groceries)' WHEN 'mortgage' THEN 'Home (mortgage)' WHEN 'online-services' THEN 'Apps & subscriptions' WHEN 'electronics-homelab' THEN 'Gear / electronics' WHEN 'takeaway-delivery' THEN 'Takeaway' WHEN 'loans' THEN 'Loan payments' WHEN 'electric-gas' THEN 'Electric & gas' WHEN 'greece-family' THEN 'Family (Greece)' WHEN 'internet-mobile' THEN 'Internet / mobile' WHEN 'supplements-fitness' THEN 'Supplements' WHEN 'health-insurance-nn' THEN 'Health insurance' WHEN 'water-dunea' THEN 'Water' WHEN 'transfer' THEN 'Money moved onto the credit card' WHEN 'taxes' THEN 'Taxes' WHEN 'travel-insurance-asr' THEN 'Travel insurance' WHEN 'liability-insurance-asr' THEN 'Liability insurance' WHEN 'legal-insurance-de-vereende' THEN 'Legal insurance' WHEN 'card-fee' THEN 'Bank / card fees' ELSE COALESCE(t.category,'Not sorted yet') END AS `Where it goes`, ROUND(-SUM(t.base_amount)/6,0) AS `Per month` FROM v_spend_canonical t WHERE t.booked_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10) s ORDER BY s.`Per month` DESC

panels.title: 📋 My subscriptions — real, from Wallos

targets.rawSql: SELECT name AS `Subscription`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(monthly_eur,2,'de_DE')) AS `Per month`, cycle_label AS `Billed` FROM wallos_subs WHERE active=1 ORDER BY monthly_eur DESC LIMIT 14

panels.title: 🧾 Biggest expenses this month  (real spending, no transfers)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(booked_date,'%e %b') AS `When`, CONCAT('€ ',FORMAT(-base_amount,2,'de_DE')) AS `Amount`, LEFT(payee_raw,34) AS `Paid to` FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY base_amount ASC LIMIT 8

panels.title: 🤝 Months to clear Ilias + Christos  (if I follow the plan)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CEIL((SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='debt_friends') / GREATEST((SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='income_monthly')-(SELECT v FROM budget_plan WHERE k='REDACTED_6c219e94'),1)) AS m

panels.title: 📆 Net — last full month  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(base_amount),2,'de_DE')) AS Net FROM transactions WHERE (account_id IN ('ing-checking','ing-card') OR (account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797')) AND booked_date >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 1 MONTH),'%Y-%m-01') AND booked_date < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%Y-%m-01')

panels.title: 📆 Net — last 13 months  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(base_amount),2,'de_DE')) AS Net FROM transactions WHERE (account_id IN ('ing-checking','ing-card') OR (account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797')) AND $__timeFilter(booked_date)

panels.title: 📊 Net per month — what actually stayed  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(booked_date,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS time, ROUND(SUM(base_amount),2) AS Net FROM transactions WHERE (account_id IN ('ing-checking','ing-card') OR (account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797')) AND $__timeFilter(booked_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 📈 Cumulative trajectory — am I climbing or sinking  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, ROUND(SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY t),2) AS `Cumulative net` FROM (SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(booked_date,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') t, SUM(base_amount) net FROM transactions WHERE (account_id IN ('ing-checking','ing-card') OR (account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797')) AND $__timeFilter(booked_date) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY t

panels.title: 📥 Income per month — what I earned  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(t.booked_date,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS time, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.base_amount>0 AND c.kind='income' THEN t.base_amount ELSE 0 END),2) AS Income FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON t.category=c.slug WHERE (t.account_id IN ('ing-checking','ing-card') OR (t.account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND t.account_id<>'ing-sav-k797')) AND $__timeFilter(t.booked_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🏦 My savings this year  (I emptied them to cover overspending)  ·  €

targets.rawSql: SELECT t AS time, ROUND((SELECT -SUM(base_amount) FROM transactions WHERE account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797' AND booked_date>'2025-05-07') + SUM(net) OVER (ORDER BY t),0) AS `Savings` FROM (SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(booked_date,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') t, SUM(base_amount) net FROM transactions WHERE account_id LIKE 'ing-sav-%' AND account_id<>'ing-sav-k797' AND $__timeFilter(booked_date) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY t

panels.title: 📊 Spending by category — per month (top 10, stacked)  ·  €

targets.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(t.booked_date,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS time, COALESCE(top.category,'other') AS metric, ROUND(-SUM(t.base_amount),2) AS value FROM v_spend_canonical t LEFT JOIN (SELECT category FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE booked_date>=DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 13 MONTH) AND category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(base_amount) ASC LIMIT 10) top ON top.category=t.category WHERE $__timeFilter(t.booked_date) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 📊 What changed — where my spending shifted (Jan–Jun 2025 vs 2026)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE cat WHEN 'online-shopping' THEN 'Online shopping' WHEN 'online-services' THEN 'Apps & subscriptions' WHEN 'electronics-homelab' THEN 'Gear / electronics' WHEN 'groceries' THEN 'Food (groceries)' WHEN 'takeaway-delivery' THEN 'Takeaway' WHEN 'health-insurance-nn' THEN 'Health insurance' WHEN 'internet-mobile' THEN 'Internet / mobile' WHEN 'water-dunea' THEN 'Water' WHEN 'supplements-fitness' THEN 'Supplements' WHEN 'loans' THEN 'Loan payments' ELSE cat END AS `Category`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(y25,0,'de_DE')) AS `Jan–Jun 2025`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(y26,0,'de_DE')) AS `Jan–Jun 2026`, CONCAT(IF(y26-y25>=0,'▲ +€ ','▼ −€ '), FORMAT(ABS(y26-y25),0,'de_DE')) AS `Change` FROM (SELECT category AS cat, ROUND(-SUM(IF(booked_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-06-30',base_amount,0)),0) AS y25, ROUND(-SUM(IF(booked_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-06-30',base_amount,0)),0) AS y26 FROM v_spend_canonical WHERE category IS NOT NULL AND category NOT IN ('transfer','greece-family','cash','card-spending','mortgage','electric-gas','taxes','disability-supp-asr') GROUP BY category) t WHERE ABS(y26-y25)>=60 ORDER BY ABS(y26-y25) DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: 🤖 Projects & AI — per pay-cycle (23rd → 22nd)  (€)
panels.description: The one spending block still growing. A pay-cycle runs payday-to-payday (~the 23rd). The current cycle is partial until the next credit-card statement lands (~the 5th).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
 CASE q.category
  WHEN 'zz' THEN '— block total —'
  WHEN 'llm-ai' THEN 'LLM & AI vendors (Claude, Mistral, Moonshot, …)'
  WHEN 'online-services' THEN 'Online services (hosting, domains, tools)'
  WHEN 'REDACTED_d45e5ab5' THEN 'Project AGORA — market data'
  WHEN 'project-omoikane' THEN 'Project Omoikane — search API'
  WHEN 'project-mulecube' THEN 'Project Mulecube — ads'
  WHEN 'project-logos' THEN 'Project Logos'
  WHEN 'project-meshsat' THEN 'Project Meshsat — satellite IoT'
  ELSE q.category END AS `Projects & AI`,
 CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(q.c0,2,'de_DE')) AS `this cycle*`,
 CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(q.c1,2,'de_DE')) AS `last cycle`,
 CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(q.c2,2,'de_DE')) AS `2 cycles back`,
 CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(q.c3,2,'de_DE')) AS `3 cycles back`
FROM (
 SELECT COALESCE(category,'zz') AS category,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d=0 THEN amt END),0),2) c0,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d=1 THEN amt END),0),2) c1,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d=2 THEN amt END),0),2) c2,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d=3 THEN amt END),0),2) c3
 FROM (SELECT category, -base_amount amt,
   PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(),INTERVAL 22 DAY),'%Y%m'),
               DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(booked_date,INTERVAL 22 DAY),'%Y%m')) d
  FROM v_spend_canonical
  WHERE booked_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 5 MONTH)
    AND category IN ('llm-ai','online-services','REDACTED_d45e5ab5','project-omoikane',
                     'project-mulecube','project-logos','project-meshsat')) x
 WHERE d BETWEEN 0 AND 3
 GROUP BY category WITH ROLLUP
) q
ORDER BY (q.category='zz'), q.c0 DESC, q.c1 DESC

panels.title: 🔄 Bank sync

targets.rawSql: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MAX(last_synced_at), NOW()) v FROM sync_state WHERE mode='gocardless'

panels.title: 🔐 Days left before I re-approve the bank

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(access_expires_at), NOW()) v FROM sync_state WHERE access_expires_at IS NOT NULL

panels.title: 📖 Folder scan (bonusradar)
panels.description: Weekly folder OCR: pages read / queued / stuck and this week's offer harvest. Stuck pages auto-retry while the folder edition is live.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
 CONCAT((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='done'),0)    FROM folder_pages),' read')   AS `pages`,
 CONCAT((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='pending'),0) FROM folder_pages),' queued') AS `queued`,
 CONCAT((SELECT COALESCE(SUM(status='failed'),0)  FROM folder_pages),' stuck')  AS `stuck`,
 CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM retail_offers WHERE source='folder-ocr'
   AND week_tag=DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(),'%x-W%v')),' offers/wk')                  AS `harvest`

options.content:
## 🛍️ Online orders — pulled from my email receipts
Every order from Amazon, Thuisbezorgd, eBay, bol.com, Albert Heijn, AliExpress & Flink. **Spend** = what the receipt actually stated (not every email carries a total — see the €-coverage column).

panels.title: 🛍️ Spent on online orders — all time  (€)

targets.rawSql: SELECT CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(spend_eur),2,'de_DE')) AS v FROM v_orders

panels.title: 📦 Orders placed — all time

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM v_orders

panels.title: 🚫 Cancelled or refunded

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(is_cancelled) AS v FROM v_orders

panels.title: 🛒 Orders by shop — all time
panels.description: Order counts are complete; 'Spend' only sums orders whose email stated a total (€-coverage). Albert Heijn spend comes from the PDF invoices, hence its low coverage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT merchant AS `Shop`, COUNT(*) AS `Orders`, SUM(is_cancelled) AS `Cancelled`, CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(SUM(spend_eur),2,'de_DE')) AS `Spend (from receipts)`, CONCAT(ROUND(100*SUM(total IS NOT NULL)/COUNT(*)),'%') AS `€-coverage`, CONCAT(YEAR(MIN(ordered_at)),'–',YEAR(MAX(ordered_at))) AS `History` FROM v_orders GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY SUM(spend_eur) DESC

panels.title: 📈 Online orders per month — last 24 months

targets.rawSql: SELECT STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at,'%Y-%m'),'-01'),'%Y-%m-%d') AS time, COUNT(*) AS `Orders` FROM v_orders WHERE ordered_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 MONTH AND ordered_at <= NOW() GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 🧾 Recent orders

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(ordered_at) AS `Date`, merchant AS `Shop`, CASE WHEN spend_eur IS NULL THEN '—' ELSE CONCAT('€ ', FORMAT(spend_eur,2,'de_DE')) END AS `Amount`, status AS `Status` FROM v_orders WHERE ordered_at <= NOW() ORDER BY ordered_at DESC LIMIT 15
